blocking.claim: "Late afternoon is the hinge point: the 2026-season checkpoint closes at 17:00, private cars can start filtering back down the access road just as the light turns gold over the pines, and the last scheduled bus and boat departures, at 20:30, are still hours off."
blocking.problem: Cross-surface contradiction. The page establishes elsewhere (travel.mdx "Vehicle Access Restrictions", showcase.access_note, showcase.things_to_know) that there are TWO separate, additive car restrictions: the 2023 checkpoint (9:30-17:00) AND the original 2016 Playa Conectada scheme, which independently bars private cars from the access road every day from 1 June to 30 September between 10:00 and 18:00. The golden-hour claim that cars 'can start filtering back' the moment the checkpoint closes at 17:00 ignores that the Playa Conectada restriction (10:00-18:00) is still active for another hour during the summer season the checkpoint operates in.
